title: MLX arctan: finite weighted derivatives collapse to zero after intermediate overflow
limits: In Apple MLX CPU float32, arctan differentiation forms 1+x² before division. For finite x=-2^64 and seed=-2^120, x² overflows and the JVP/VJP becomes signed zero although the correctly rounded result is -0.00390625. A scale-aware research candidate reduces 352 discrepancies per tested layout to zero, with documented higher-order residuals. CPU float32 only; no real model/device/customer impact; candidate has documented higher-order residuals.
measured_chain: v/(1+x^2) -> x*x overflows -> -0.0 instead of -0.00390625 -> synthetic update 1.0 instead of 1.5 and threshold decision flips.
